∀ {k : ℕ} {S : Type} (M : Turing.MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (q₀ : S),
  Complexity.LogProg.cleanTM M q₀ =
    { q₀ := Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.init q₀,
      tr := fun x x_1 x_2 =>
        match x, x_1, x_2 with
        | Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.init q, x, x_3 =>
          { inputTape := 0, workTapes := Fin.append Complexity.LogProg.idleK fun x => (some (some true), 0),
            output := none, state := some (Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.sim q) }
        | Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.sim q, a, w =>
          have act := M.tr q a fun i => w (Fin.castAdd k i);
          { inputTape := act.inputTape,
            workTapes :=
              Fin.append act.workTapes fun i =>
                (if w (Fin.natAdd k i) = some true then none else some (some false), (act.workTapes i).2),
            output := act.output,
            state :=
              match act.state with
              | some q' => some (Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.sim q')
              | none =>
                if h : 0 < k then some (Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.cl ⟨0, h⟩ Complexity.LogProg.CPh.mark) else none }
        | Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.cl i Complexity.LogProg.CPh.mark, x, w =>
          Complexity.LogProg.clAct i none (if w (Fin.natAdd k i) = some true then none else some (some false)) 0
            (some (Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.cl i Complexity.LogProg.CPh.goR))
        | Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.cl i Complexity.LogProg.CPh.goR, x, w =>
          if (w (Fin.natAdd k i)).isSome = true then
            Complexity.LogProg.clAct i none none 1 (some (Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.cl i Complexity.LogProg.CPh.goR))
          else
            Complexity.LogProg.clAct i none none (-1)
              (some (Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.cl i Complexity.LogProg.CPh.erase))
        | Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.cl i Complexity.LogProg.CPh.erase, x, w =>
          match w (Fin.natAdd k i) with
          | some true =>
            Complexity.LogProg.clAct i (some none) none (-1)
              (some (Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.cl i Complexity.LogProg.CPh.erase))
          | some false =>
            Complexity.LogProg.clAct i (some none) (some none) (-1)
              (some (Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.cl i Complexity.LogProg.CPh.erase))
          | none =>
            Complexity.LogProg.clAct i none none 1 (some (Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.cl i Complexity.LogProg.CPh.back))
        | Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.cl i Complexity.LogProg.CPh.back, x, w =>
          match w (Fin.natAdd k i) with
          | some true => Complexity.LogProg.clAct i none (some none) 0 (Complexity.LogProg.clNext i)
          | x =>
            Complexity.LogProg.clAct i none none 1
              (some (Complexity.LogProg.CleanSt.cl i Complexity.LogProg.CPh.back)) }

∀ {m d kD : ℕ} {Λ SD : Type} (P : Complexity.LogProg.RProg m d Λ) (D : Turing.MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
  (x : Option Bool) (x_1 : Fin (m + kD) → Option Bool) (l : Λ),
  Complexity.LogProg.ctr P D q0 (Complexity.LogProg.CSt.prog l) x x_1 =
    match P.call l with
    | none =>
      have a := P.tm.tr l x fun r => x_1 (Fin.castAdd kD r);
      { inputTape := a.inputTape, workTapes := Fin.append a.workTapes Complexity.LogProg.dIdle, output := a.output,
        state := Option.map Complexity.LogProg.CSt.prog a.state }
    | some cs =>
      { inputTape := 0,
        workTapes := Fin.append (fun r => (none, if r ∈ cs.args then -1 else 0)) Complexity.LogProg.dIdle,
        output := none, state := some (Complexity.LogProg.CSt.sim l (q0 cs.dec) 0 false true none) }

∀ {m d kD : ℕ} {Λ SD : Type} (P : Complexity.LogProg.RProg m d Λ) (D : Turing.MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
  (x : Option Bool) (x_1 : Fin (m + kD) → Option Bool) (l : Λ) (q : SD) (s : Fin (m + 1)) (par dir : Bool)
  (res : Option Bool),
  Complexity.LogProg.ctr P D q0 (Complexity.LogProg.CSt.sim l q s par dir res) x x_1 =
    match P.call l with
    | none => { inputTape := 0, workTapes := fun x => (none, 0), output := none, state := none }
    | some cs =>
      have rd :=
        if ↑s = 0 then x else if hm : 0 < m then x_1 (Fin.castAdd kD (Complexity.LogProg.segReg cs (↑s) hm)) else none;
      have ic := Complexity.LogProg.isCharRead cs.mode (↑s) rd;
      have vs := Complexity.LogProg.virtSym cs.mode (↑s) (cs.args.length + 1) dir rd;
      have a := D.tr q vs fun i => x_1 (Fin.natAdd m i);
      have g :=
        Complexity.LogProg.gstep (Complexity.LogProg.segDbl cs ↑s) (decide (↑s + 1 = cs.args.length + 1))
          (decide (↑s = 0)) (↑s) par dir ic a.inputTape;
      have res' := res <|> a.output;
      { inputTape := if ↑s = 0 then g.2.2.2 else 0,
        workTapes :=
          Fin.append
            (fun r =>
              (none, if h : 0 < m then if ↑s ≠ 0 ∧ r = Complexity.LogProg.segReg cs (↑s) h then g.2.2.2 else 0 else 0))
            a.workTapes,
        output := none,
        state :=
          some
            (match a.state with
            | some q' => Complexity.LogProg.CSt.sim l q' (Complexity.LogProg.toFin m g.1) g.2.1 g.2.2.1 res'
            | none => Complexity.LogProg.CSt.ret1 l (Complexity.LogProg.toFin m g.1) g.2.2.1 (res'.getD false)) }

  (tp : Complexity.LogProg.TPos),
  Complexity.LogProg.TPos.Valid (Complexity.LogProg.callSegs cs x W) s tp →
    ∀ (G1 : ℕ) (T2 : Complexity.LogProg.TPos),
      Complexity.LogProg.TPos.Valid (Complexity.LogProg.callSegs cs x W) G1 T2 →
        ∀ (mv : SignType),
          G1 = s ∧
                Complexity.LogProg.trackPos (Complexity.LogProg.callSegs cs x W) s T2 =
                  Complexity.LogProg.trackPos (Complexity.LogProg.callSegs cs x W) s tp + ↑mv ∨
              mv = 0 ∧
                (G1 = s + 1 ∧ tp = Complexity.LogProg.TPos.right ∧ T2 = Complexity.LogProg.TPos.left ∨
                  G1 + 1 = s ∧ tp = Complexity.LogProg.TPos.left ∧ T2 = Complexity.LogProg.TPos.right) →
            ∀ (p : Fin (x.length + 2)),
              ↑p = Complexity.LogProg.inPos cs x W s tp →
                ↑(Turing.moveInputPos p (if s = 0 then mv else 0)) = Complexity.LogProg.inPos cs x W G1 T2

              Complexity.LogProg.regPos c0 cs W G1 T2 r

∀ {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} {x : List Bool} (c0 : Turing.Cfg m Bool Λ x) (cs : Complexity.LogProg.CallSpec m d Λ)
  (W : Fin m → List Bool) (s : ℕ) (tp : Complexity.LogProg.TPos) (r : Fin m),
  Complexity.LogProg.regPos c0 cs W s tp r =
    if r ∈ cs.args then
      if List.idxOf r cs.args + 1 < s then
        ↑(Complexity.LogProg.wlen (Complexity.LogProg.callSegs cs x W) (List.idxOf r cs.args + 1))
      else
        if s < List.idxOf r cs.args + 1 then -1
        else Complexity.LogProg.trackPos (Complexity.LogProg.callSegs cs x W) s tp
    else c0.workTapePos r

  Complexity.obliviousSchedule W a =
    { k := W.k + 3, State := Complexity.OblPhase W.State a, fintypeState := Complexity.instFintypeOblPhase,
      decEqState := fun a_1 b => Complexity.instDecidableEqOblPhase a_1 b,
      tm :=
        { q₀ := Complexity.OblPhase.init,
          tr := fun q inp ws =>
            have bit := ws (Fin.natAdd W.k 0);
            have unary := ws (Fin.natAdd W.k 1);
            have guide := ws (Fin.natAdd W.k 2);
            have stay := (none, 0);
            have move := fun d => (none, d);
            have put := fun s d => (some (some s), d);
            have act := fun q inp b u g => Complexity.oblAction (some q) inp b u g;
            have interior :=
              if guide = some Complexity.OblSymbol.origin then Complexity.OblSymbol.origin
              else Complexity.OblSymbol.inside;
            match q with
            | Complexity.OblPhase.init =>
              act (Complexity.OblPhase.clock W.tm.q₀) 0 (put Complexity.OblSymbol.origin SignType.pos)
                (put Complexity.OblSymbol.origin SignType.pos) stay
            | Complexity.OblPhase.clock s =>
              have action :=
                W.tm.tr s (Option.map (fun x => false) inp) fun i => Complexity.clockBit (ws (Fin.castAdd 3 i));
              { inputTape := action.inputTape,
                workTapes := fun i =>
                  Fin.addCases
                    (fun i =>
                      (Option.map (Option.map Complexity.OblSymbol.bit) (action.workTapes i).1, (action.workTapes i).2))
                    (fun j =>
                      if ↑j = 0 then
                        match action.output with
                        | none => stay
                        | some b => put (Complexity.OblSymbol.bit b) SignType.pos
                      else stay)
                    i,
                output := none,
                state :=
                  some ((Option.map Complexity.OblPhase.clock action.state).getD Complexity.OblPhase.resetStart) }
            | Complexity.OblPhase.resetStart => act Complexity.OblPhase.resetScan SignType.neg stay stay stay
            | Complexity.OblPhase.resetScan =>
              match inp with
              | none => act Complexity.OblPhase.copyLeft SignType.pos stay stay stay
              | some val => act Complexity.OblPhase.resetScan SignType.neg stay stay stay
            | Complexity.OblPhase.copyLeft => act Complexity.OblPhase.copyLeftWrite 0 stay stay (move SignType.neg)
            | Complexity.OblPhase.copyLeftWrite =>
              act Complexity.OblPhase.copyFirst 0 stay stay (put Complexity.OblSymbol.inside SignType.pos)
            | Complexity.OblPhase.copyFirst =>
              match inp with
              | none => act Complexity.OblPhase.copyReturn 0 stay stay (put Complexity.OblSymbol.origin 0)
              | some val =>
                act Complexity.OblPhase.copyMore SignType.pos stay stay (put Complexity.OblSymbol.origin SignType.pos)
            | Complexity.OblPhase.copyMore =>
              match inp with
              | none => act Complexity.OblPhase.copyReturn 0 stay stay (put Complexity.OblSymbol.inside 0)
              | some val =>
                act Complexity.OblPhase.copyMore SignType.pos stay stay (put Complexity.OblSymbol.inside SignType.pos)
            | Complexity.OblPhase.copyReturn =>
              if guide = some Complexity.OblSymbol.origin then act Complexity.OblPhase.budgetStart 0 stay stay stay
              else act Complexity.OblPhase.copyReturn 0 stay stay (move SignType.neg)
            | Complexity.OblPhase.budgetStart => act Complexity.OblPhase.budgetBack 0 (move SignType.neg) stay stay
            | Complexity.OblPhase.budgetBack =>
              if bit = some Complexity.OblSymbol.origin then

              else act Complexity.OblPhase.budgetBack 0 (move SignType.neg) stay stay
            | Complexity.OblPhase.append i =>
              if h : ↑i < a + 1 then
                act (Complexity.OblPhase.append ⟨↑i + 1, ⋯⟩) 0 stay (put Complexity.OblSymbol.unit SignType.pos) stay

            | Complexity.OblPhase.borrow carry =>
              match bit with

                act (Complexity.OblPhase.borrow (carry && !b)) 0
                  (put (Complexity.OblSymbol.bit (b ^^ carry)) SignType.pos) stay stay

                else act Complexity.OblPhase.budgetStart 0 stay stay stay
            | Complexity.OblPhase.unaryStart => act Complexity.OblPhase.unaryBack 0 stay (move SignType.neg) stay
            | Complexity.OblPhase.unaryBack =>
              if unary = some Complexity.OblSymbol.origin then
                act (Complexity.OblPhase.layoutRight 0) 0 stay (move SignType.pos) stay
              else act Complexity.OblPhase.unaryBack 0 stay (move SignType.neg) stay
            | Complexity.OblPhase.layoutRight i =>

              else

            | Complexity.OblPhase.layoutLeft i =>
              if unary = some Complexity.OblSymbol.unit then
                act (Complexity.OblPhase.layoutLeft (Complexity.nextThird i)) 0 stay
                  (move (if ↑i = 2 then SignType.pos else 0)) (put interior SignType.neg)

            | Complexity.OblPhase.leftEdge =>
              act Complexity.OblPhase.unaryReset 0 stay (move SignType.neg) (put (Complexity.OblSymbol.edge false) 0)

              if unary = some Complexity.OblSymbol.origin then
                act Complexity.OblPhase.startCenter 0 stay (move SignType.pos) stay
              else act Complexity.OblPhase.unaryReset 0 stay (move SignType.neg) stay
            | Complexity.OblPhase.startCenter =>
              if guide = some Complexity.OblSymbol.origin then act Complexity.OblPhase.macroCheck 0 stay stay stay
              else act Complexity.OblPhase.startCenter 0 stay stay (move SignType.pos)
            | Complexity.OblPhase.macroCheck =>
              if unary = some Complexity.OblSymbol.unit then act Complexity.OblPhase.seekLeft 0 stay stay stay
              else Complexity.oblAction none 0 stay stay stay
            | Complexity.OblPhase.seekLeft =>
              if guide = some (Complexity.OblSymbol.edge false) then
                act Complexity.OblPhase.forward 0 stay stay (move SignType.pos)
              else act Complexity.OblPhase.seekLeft 0 stay stay (move SignType.neg)
            | Complexity.OblPhase.forward =>
              if guide = some (Complexity.OblSymbol.edge true) then
                act Complexity.OblPhase.backward 0 stay stay (move SignType.neg)
              else act Complexity.OblPhase.forward 0 stay stay (move SignType.pos)
            | Complexity.OblPhase.backward =>
              if guide = some (Complexity.OblSymbol.edge false) then
                act Complexity.OblPhase.returnCenter 0 stay stay (move SignType.pos)
              else act Complexity.OblPhase.backward 0 stay stay (move SignType.neg)
            | Complexity.OblPhase.returnCenter =>
              if guide = some Complexity.OblSymbol.origin then
                act Complexity.OblPhase.macroCheck 0 stay (move SignType.pos) stay
              else act Complexity.OblPhase.returnCenter 0 stay stay (move SignType.pos) } }

        ∀ (inp : Option Γ) (work : Fin k → Option Γ),

    ∀ (c : Turing.Cfg k Γ S x) (w : List Bool),

        Turing.NDTM.runWith w (Turing.Cfg.mapState (⇑emb) c) = Turing.Cfg.mapState (⇑emb) (Turing.NDTM.runWith w c)

  (host : Turing.NDTM k Γ H) (emb : S ↪ H) (good : S → Prop),
  (∀ (b : Bool) (q : S),
      good q →
        ∀ (inp : Option Γ) (work : Fin k → Option Γ),
          host.tr b (emb q) inp work = Turing.Action.mapState (⇑emb) (src.tr q inp work)) →
    ∀ (c : Turing.Cfg k Γ S x) (w : List Bool),
      (∀ u < w.length, ∀ (q : S), (Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom c u).state = some q → good q) →
        Turing.NDTM.runWith w (Turing.Cfg.mapState (⇑emb) c) =
          Turing.Cfg.mapState (⇑emb) (Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom c w.length)

        ∀ (b : Bool),
          Turing.NDTM.stepWith b (Turing.Cfg.mapState (⇑emb) c) = Turing.Cfg.mapState (⇑emb) (Turing.NDTM.stepWith b c)
